[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended restaurants in the Haight-Ashbury neighborhood: Zuni Cafe, The Pork Store Cafe, Nopalito, The Alembic, Magnolia Gastropub, The Pork Store BBQ, Cafe Cole.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Zuni Cafe is known for brick oven roasted chicken and Mediterranean-inspired dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Pork Store Cafe is a casual spot known for breakfast and brunch options, including the "Pork Store Sandwich."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nopalito offers organic, farm-to-table Mexican dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Alembic is a gastropub with creative American cuisine and craft cocktails.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Magnolia Gastropub serves pub fare and craft beer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Pork Store BBQ offers a variety of smoked meats.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cafe Cole is a family-owned cafe with coffee, sandwiches, salads, and baked goods.  
[FACT] User is looking for a place to grab breakfast.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Pork Store Cafe serves breakfast all day, every day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The operating hours for The Pork Store Cafe are Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM, Saturday and Sunday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular breakfast items at The Pork Store Cafe include the "Pork Store Sandwich," omelets, pancakes, waffles, and breakfast burritos.
